source.main: USDA National Nutrient Database for Standard Reference, Release 28 (SR Legacy in FoodData Central). Values per 100 g of edible portion.
source.ods: Biotin, iodine and omega-3 values from NIH Office of Dietary Supplements fact sheets (Table 2 in each), converted to per 100 g. Only foods listed there have these values.
source.fnd: Where marked, values come from USDA Foundation Foods, which USDA updates every April and October.
source.levels: Rich source: one serving gives 20% or more of the FDA Daily Value. Good source: 10-19%. Servings are FDA reference amounts (21 CFR 101.12).
